extracted.intended_audience: Authors and review teams preparing Cochrane systematic reviews of interventions
extracted.subtask_description: Standards and methodological guidance for planning, conducting, analysing, and reporting Cochrane systematic reviews of healthcare interventions, including core MECIR expectations and specialised topic guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Planning a review
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on planning a review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Handbook includes guidance on the standard methods applicable to every review (planning a review, searching and selecting studies, data collection, risk of bias assessment, statistical analysis, GRADE and interpreting results). All authors should consult the Handbook for guidance on the methods used in Cochrane systematic reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Searching and selecting studies
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on searching for studies and selecting those to include in the review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Handbook provides standard methods for searching and selecting studies as part of the core methods applicable to every review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data collection
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on data collection from included studies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Handbook includes methods for data collection that apply to Cochrane systematic reviews; authors should follow these procedures when extracting and managing study data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Risk of bias assessment
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for assessing risk of bias in included studies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Handbook describes approaches to risk of bias assessment as part of the standard methodological toolkit for Cochrane reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statistical analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on appropriate statistical analysis and synthesis of study results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Handbook includes guidance on statistical analysis applicable to review authors (e.g., meta-analysis methods and related statistical considerations).

rubrics_metrics.name: GRADE and interpreting results
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of GRADE and approaches to interpreting review results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Handbook provides guidance on GRADE and interpreting the results of systematic reviews as part of the standard methods applicable to every review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Methodological Expectations for Cochrane Intervention Reviews (MECIR)
rubrics_metrics.description: Core standards generally expected of Cochrane reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Key aspects of Handbook guidance are collated as the Methodological Expectations for Cochrane Intervention Reviews (MECIR). These provide core standards that are generally expected of Cochrane reviews. Each MECIR item includes a link to a relevant Handbook chapter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-randomized studies
rubrics_metrics.description: Specialised guidance for reviews that include non-randomized studies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Handbook includes specialised topics such as non-randomized studies, providing methods tailored to the challenges of non-randomised evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adverse effects
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on identifying, extracting, and analysing adverse effects/harms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Handbook covers specialised topics including adverse effects and provides guidance relevant to assessing harms in reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complex interventions
rubrics_metrics.description: Methods guidance for reviews addressing complex interventions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Handbook includes guidance on complex interventions as a specialised topic, helping authors address complexity in interventions and evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equity
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on considering equity in reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Equity is listed among specialised topics; the Handbook provides methods for considering equity issues within systematic reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economics
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on incorporating economic evidence or analyses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Handbook includes economics as a specialised topic, offering guidance for reviews that address economic outcomes or cost-effectiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patient-reported outcomes
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance related to patient-reported outcomes and their use in reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Handbook covers patient-reported outcomes among specialised topics and provides relevant methodological advice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Individual patient data
rubrics_metrics.description: Methods for reviews using individual patient data (IPD).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Handbook includes specialised guidance on individual patient data reviews, addressing the specific methods and issues for IPD meta-analyses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prospective meta-analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on planning and conducting prospective meta-analyses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prospective meta-analysis is included as a specialised topic in the Handbook, with methods for coordinating and analysing prospectively planned pooled studies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Qualitative research
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on including and synthesising qualitative research within reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Handbook includes qualitative research among specialised topics and provides methods for integrating qualitative evidence in reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirement to consult the Handbook
rubrics_metrics.description: Expectation that all Cochrane review authors consult the Handbook for methodological guidance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All authors should consult the Handbook for guidance on the methods used in Cochrane systematic reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to cite the Handbook
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructions for citing the Handbook online and in print.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To cite the full Handbook online, use: Higgins JPT, Thomas J, Chandler J, Cumpston M, Li T, Page MJ, et al, editor(s). Cochrane Handbook for Systematic Reviews of Interventions version 6.5 (updated August 2024). Cochrane, 2024. Available from www.cochrane.org/handbook. Print citation format for the 2nd Edition is also provided. Details for citing individual chapters are available in each chapter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Academic / non-commercial re-use of Handbook material
rubrics_metrics.description: Permissions and rules for academic or other non-commercial reuse.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You do not need to request permission to use short quotations (though these must be appropriately cited), or to cite the Handbook as a source. If you intend to reproduce material using screenshots, including exact figures or tables or including lengthy direct quotations (more than 5 lines of text), then please fill in this form to request permission to re-use material from the Handbook. Requests will be sent to the Cochrane Support team who will notify Senior Editors; if approved, requests will be granted free of charge on condition that the source is acknowledged.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commercial re-use of Handbook material
rubrics_metrics.description: Permissions process and contact for commercial reuse.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commercial re-use includes any use of the Handbook that will be used in a product for which there is a monetary fee, and/or where it is associated in any way with any product or service. For all enquiries related to commercial re-use of Handbook material please contact Wiley Global Permissions, John Wiley & Sons, Ltd.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contacting the Handbook editors / support
rubrics_metrics.description: Contact information for further information and Handbook enquiries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For further information and for any Handbook enquiries please contact: support@cochrane.org. The Handbook editorial team includes named Senior and Associate Scientific Editors and a Managing Editor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Versioning and previous editions
rubrics_metrics.description: Information on previous versions and how the Handbook has changed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Details on how the Handbook has changed compared to previous versions can be found on the Versions and changes page. Archived copies of previous versions (6.4, 6.3, etc.) are available as listed.
